last_note: Implementation complete. Reused UserProfileService.resolvePhotoUrl (already DRY-authenticated-photo path) and UserProfileService.updateProfile (already the shared PATCH /users/me status-write path) instead of duplicating either, per the ticket's own DRY/reuse instructions. discovery-service's real /scan/start, /scan/nearby, /scan/stop, /scan/location endpoints are wired for real (confirmed via ScanController.java/ScanSessionServiceImpl.java/ScanQueryServiceImpl.java source), not mocked -- including discovering that ScanSessionServiceImpl.startScan never seeds the scan:{id}:location Redis key itself (only SQL destination_lat/lng), so RadarComponent.startScan() now chains a PUT /scan/location call with the same position right after /scan/start succeeds, then keeps it fresh via navigator.geolocation.watchPosition for the life of the scan (REQUIREMENTS.md §3's 'tracked continuously' requirement) -- without this, /scan/nearby would silently return an empty result forever (ScanQueryServiceImpl's own null-location guard fails open, not with an error). Known gaps flagged in .claude/notes/follow-ups.md 'From T064': (1) UserCardResponse doesn't yet return rating/destination/leaving-in/route-match/language -- DiscoveredUserCardDto models them optional, template *ngIf's them away rather than fabricating; (2) no bearing field, so radar dot angle is a stable cosmetic placement, not real compass direction; (3) destination_lat/lng sent to /scan/start use the caller's current position as a placeholder pending a real Google Maps Platform destination picker (no ticket for one exists yet); (4) hard tab/browser close doesn't revert status -- only in-SPA navigation away is covered; (5) GPS mode badge color conflict between the approved mockup (violet) and T064's own ticket text ('green') -- implemented to match the mockup per the ticket's own 'mockup is source of truth' instruction, flagged for Tech Lead sign-off. Also updated app-routing.module.ts's root redirect ('' -> 'radar' instead of unconditional 'auth') and ProfileSetupComponent.startExploring() (navigates to '/radar') now that a real protected home screen exists, closing a gap both files' own prior comments explicitly anticipated.
